description_en: If you no longer need a verification scheme, you can call this operation or delete the scheme in the Phone Number Verification Service console
description_zh: 如果您不再使用某个认证方案，需要删除方案时，调用此接口或在号码认证服务控制台删除认证方案
name: DeleteVerifyScheme

parameters.help_en: The scheme code. Get this value from the `SchemeCode` parameter in the response of the [CreateVerifyScheme](~~CreateVerifyScheme~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 方案号。本参数值可以从[CreateVerifyScheme](~~CreateVerifyScheme~~)接口的返回参数`SchemeCode`获取
parameters.name: scheme_code

Code.description_en:
The status code.

OK means the request succeeded.

For more information, see [Server-side API return codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85198.html）
Code.description_zh:
状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[服务端API返回码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85198.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Result.description_en:
The result of the operation. Valid values:

true: The scheme was deleted.

false: The scheme failed to be deleted
Result.description_zh:
返回结果。取值：

true：删除成功
false：删除失败
